PhysioAnnotationHub: anatomical and clinical knowledge graph for the ecosystem

Source: R/PhysioAnnotationHub-package.R
PhysioAnnotationHub-package.Rd

A lightweight, dependency-free (base-R only) annotation hub for the [PhysioExperiment](https://github.com/x-biosignal/PhysioExperiment) ecosystem. It bundles curated anatomical ontology data – muscles, bones, nerves – plus clinical codes (ICD-10, ICF) and an anatomical knowledge graph, and exposes them through a small query interface. All data ships as CSVs under `inst/extdata`; nothing is downloaded at run time.

Loading the hub

* [loadAnnotationHub()] – read all bundled datasets into one cached hub object (printing it gives a one-line summary of what is available).

Anatomical queries

* [getMuscleAnnotation()], [getBoneAnnotation()], [getNerveAnnotation()] – look up muscle / bone / nerve metadata by name or pattern (all rows if no name is given). * [getClinicalCodes()] – ICD-10 or ICF codes that reference a set of muscles.

Knowledge graph

* [queryKG()] – match subject-predicate-object triples. * [kgNeighbors()] – triples within N hops of an entity. * [kgShortestPath()] – shortest path between two entities. * [kgEnrichment()] – over-representation of an annotation in a muscle set.

ICF classification

* [tagICF()], [linkInstrumentToICF()] – map a metric / instrument to ICF codes. * [getCoreSet()] – a published WHO ICF Core Set for a condition. * [icfCategories()] – resolve ICF codes to their titles.

Where to go next

`vignette("annotation-hub", package = "PhysioAnnotationHub")` walks an end-to-end query. Other ecosystem packages (e.g. PhysioMSKNet) import this hub for anatomical metadata and knowledge-graph enrichment.
